# Room floor-plan designer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/room-planner/

Draw a rectangular room, add editable furniture rectangles, move them on a scaled plan and inspect overlaps before exporting.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Plan a 4 × 3 m room with a desk, bed and wardrobe while checking clearance visually.

## Limits and checks

Measurements must be verified in the real room. This simplified plan omits structural, fire, electrical and accessibility design requirements.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
